claim: For Guo-Feng Zhang's standard two-copy teleportation protocol using the thermal two-qubit Heisenberg--DM state, let \(x=J/T\), \(s=\sqrt{1+D^2}\), \(y=xs\), let \(C_{\mathrm{in}}\in(0,1]\) be the input concurrence, and \[Z=2e^{-x/2}\left(1+e^x\cosh y\right).\]Direct evaluation of the Bell-measurement Pauli channel gives the exact output concurrence \[\boxed{C_{\mathrm{out}}=\max\!\left\{\frac{4\left[C_{\mathrm{in}}e^x\sinh^2 y-2s^2\cosh y\right]}{Z^2s^2},\,0\right\}.}\]The published Eq. (14) has the same bracket but prefactor \(2\), so whenever the output is entangled it underestimates the concurrence by exactly a factor of two. The sign threshold is unchanged. Moreover, for every fixed \(J\ne0\), \(T>0\), and \(C_{\mathrm{in}}>0\), the corrected numerator is positive for all sufficiently large finite \(D\), and \[\boxed{C_{\mathrm{out}}(D)=\frac{C_{\mathrm{in}}}{1+D^2}+O\!\left(e^{-|J|\sqrt{1+D^2}/T}\right),\qquad D\to\infty.}\]Thus \(\lim_{D\to\infty}D^2C_{\mathrm{out}}=C_{\mathrm{in}}\). The source's limiting statement \(C_{\mathrm{out}}\to0\) is correct, but its interpretation that sufficiently strong DM interaction makes the teleported entanglement vanish is not: every nonzero input concurrence is eventually revived and remains strictly positive at all sufficiently large finite \(D\), with a universal algebraic \(D^{-2}\) tail.

integrity.computational_dependence: none for the proof; direct density-matrix replay is supplementary
integrity.novelty_scope: Factor-two correction to the positive output concurrence and the resulting exact strong-DM algebraic revival tail.
integrity.ownership_basis: Mathematical bibliographic records for thermal Heisenberg-chain teleportation classify Quantum channels, fidelity (81P47) as primary MSC.
integrity.prior_work_preserved: The Hamiltonian, Gibbs state, teleportation protocol, and the sign threshold are credited to the source.

scientific_limitations: The correction concerns the standard two-copy Pauli teleportation protocol and Wootters concurrence.
The zero-versus-positive threshold is unchanged by the factor-two correction.
The strong-DM limit fixes J nonzero, T positive, and input concurrence positive.
An unindexed correction or equivalent later derivation may exist.
title: Factor-two correction and strong-DM revival in thermal entanglement teleportation
